content: If PduR_<User:Lo>RxIndication is called for a n:1 rout- ing point without a FIFO configured and the <Up>_RxIndication call of the most recent request has not returned, the PDU Router shall return immediately without call- ing <Up>_RxIndication and report PduR.PDUR_E_PDU_INSTANCES_LOST to the DET module.
